The feature-gated tests exercise the real reprojection path with independent coordinates, geographic axis normalization including an explicit longitude-first case, curated precedence, and refusal cases. Feature-matrix, public documentation, lockfile, and supply-chain metadata are updated consistently. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, security, or prompt-injection issue is present. Because round 3 also approved with no findings and the substantive behavior remains sound, progress is stagnant under the required scale.
